description.value: The Liard Hot Springs Lodge Restaurant is a full-service restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner inside a remote lodge complex at Mile 497 of the Alaska Highway, roughly 300 km from Fort Nelson. It sits directly across the highway from the second-largest natural hot springs in Canada, making it a rare and welcome stop for cyclists riding the Alaska Highway through a stretch with no cell service. The lodge is open year-round and also offers rooms, campsites, and RV hookups.
